profile.headline: Distributed Systems · Cloud Platforms · Observability · Infrastructure
profile.summary:
I'm a backend and platform engineer with over 10 years of experience in delivering distributed systems, cloud platforms, and observability. I specialize in setting cross-team technical directions that improve the standardization and reliability of services.
I am dedicated to cutting infrastructure costs while mentoring engineers to ensure they can ship reliably at scale.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Owned design and rollout of an org-level OpenTelemetry observability platform (Loki, Mimir, Tempo, Grafana). Redesigned high-cost data pipelines, cutting ~$40K/month (~$480K/year) in infrastructure spend. Drove observability standards across teams, improving incident detection and reducing mean time to resolution.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Data Engineering · Python (Programming Language) · Azure DevOps Services · OpenTelemetry · Java · Mimir · Data Analysis · API Development · Cloud Infrastructure · Tempo · Continuous Integration (CI) · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Snowflake · Thoughtspot · Grafana · Loki · REST APIs · DevOps · Microsoft Azure

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
